MODEL_BLOCKER.summary: No existing, approved code path in this repository can legitimately combine KB official frozen PRE (NEO_PRE_5PROB_V2, produced by src/klpga/neo_win/pre_v2.py) with the official R1 result to produce updated CUT/TOP20/TOP10/TOP5/WIN for the 118 eligible players.
evidence: pre_v2.py (MODEL_ID=NEO_PRE_5PROB_V2, the ACTUAL model behind 2026090003_PRE_5PROB_V2_FROZEN.json) is a closed-form conditional-logit (WIN) + Plackett-Luce (TOP5/TOP10/TOP20) + binary-logit (CUT) model. Its own module docstring states it "has no tournament ID, date, player, sponsor, or post-start input" -- it is architecturally PRE-ONLY by explicit design, with zero mechanism anywhere to incorporate a real, already-played round score.

The only R1-capable model in this codebase is src/klpga/neo_win/round_update.py (BETA #001-R1, a Monte Carlo simulator that DOES combine a frozen PRE prior with a real R1 score) -- but it is a completely different, older model lineage (NEO WIN v0.1 / M4) than the one that actually produced KBs frozen PRE.

round_update.build_sim_inputs_from_frozen_snapshot() requires each pre_snapshot.predictions[i] to expose .prior_avg_round_score_to_par and .neo_consistency_stddev attributes. 2026090003_PRE_5PROB_V2_FROZEN.jsons actual prediction fields are: cut_probability, feature_missing_rule, playerCode, playerName, prior_events_n, top10_probability, top20_probability, top5_probability, win_probability -- neither required field exists anywhere in it.

scripts/104_evaluate_pre_v2.py and scripts/105_build_pre_v2.py (the only scripts that operate on NEO_PRE_5PROB_V2) never import or call round_update.py -- confirmed by direct grep, not assumption. No adapter/bridge between the two model lineages exists anywhere in the repository.

This is the SAME underlying raw-feature gap independently established earlier this session (KB_2026090003_PRE_FEATURE_COVERAGE_V1.json, commit d47a068, branch feat/kb-pre-frozen-reconstruction-v1): prior_avg_round_score_to_par / neo_consistency_stddev have 0/120 real-value coverage for KB anywhere in this sandbox, and the underlying sqlite database that would let them be recomputed is absent here too.
MODEL_BLOCKER.what_would_unblock_this: Either (a) a genuine port of round_update.py-style Monte Carlo R1-forward logic onto pre_v2.py methodology and its actual stored fields, explicitly reviewed and approved as a new model -- not attempted here per this task own "do not rebuild PRE V2" / "do not invent probabilities" rules -- or (b) running scripts/104/105s equivalent from an environment where the raw prior_avg_round_score_to_par/neo_consistency_stddev features (or the sqlite corpus behind them) are actually available, letting round_update.py be used as originally designed.
